title: Service health monitoring
description: Display city happiness as SLO compliance (latency, error rates). Show trade routes for service-to-service communication, barbarians for errors/attacks.

title: Dependency flow visualization
description: Visualize file relationships as Factorio-style animated belts. Belt color for relationship type, width for coupling strength, animation speed for exercise frequency.

title: Agent orchestration UI
description: See all active agents, assign tasks to specific agents, monitor progress, manage context windows. Command multiple units across the codebase.

title: Game start screen (harness/model selection)
description: Create the initial game start screen with harness selection (Claude Code only for now) and model selection (Opus vs Sonnet). Include project selection (open existing, recent projects).

title: Per-agent fog of war (context boundaries)
description: Each agent has its own fog of war representing its context window. Different agents have different views, overlapping views show shared knowledge.

title: Tile and fog of war system
description: Implement tile system where each tile represents a file/directory. Files start fogged until Claude analyzes them. Support 5 zoom levels: World, Region, City, Street, Interior.

title: Dynamic capability updates
description: Update capability inventory dynamically as config changes. New MCP servers or integrations appear automatically.

title: Plugin system
description: Make interface extensible: custom visualizations, new map layers, building types, resource types, advisor domains.

title: Python/TypeScript/Go debugger support
description: Implement visual debugging integration for Python (debugger/trace hooks), TypeScript (source maps), and Go (delve).

title: Test visualization with actual results
description: Visualize tests as units that 'fight' to pass (PvE metaphor). Show real metrics: execution time, pass rate, coverage, flakiness score, failure history.

title: Map visualization engine
description: Create the main map view showing codebase as territory. Implement zoomable, pannable 2D space for file/directory tiles.

title: Phase 8: Polish
description: Plugin system, theme support, and optional sound design.

title: Multiple concurrent agents
description: Support multiple agents visible on the map simultaneously. Each agent works independently on assigned tasks.

title: Advisor consultation UI
description: Allow selecting an advisor and asking questions in their domain. Advisor executes as real subagent with access to relevant tools.

title: Claude tool interception
description: Intercept Claude Code tool calls to drive visualizations. File reads/edits update map and reveal fog. Build/test runs trigger building/unit animations. Subagent calls show advisor panel activity.

title: Insight generation from real analysis
description: Advisors proactively surface insights based on code changes, build/test results, and patterns in their domain.

title: Phase 7: Multi-Agent Future
description: Multiple concurrent agents, per-agent fog of war (context boundaries), and agent orchestration UI.

title: Bazel CGO static linking broken
description: Bazel tests fail to link with undefined reference errors for libc functions (mmap, malloc, etc.) when using CGO with static linking. This appears to be a Nix/Bazel interaction issue. Tests work with 'go test' but fail with 'bazel test'. Workaround: use 'go test' for now.

title: Build system adapters
description: Create adapters for npm, Bazel, and cargo build systems. Extract real build times, cache hit rates, success rates, dependency counts.

title: Visual debugging mode
description: Use belts for visual debugging - watch data flow through functions. Show inputs, step-by-step operations, and outputs.

title: Phase 0: Foundation
description: Core foundation for CodingGame. Includes game start screen, keyboard navigation framework, and basic prompt interaction loop.

title: Capability clustering visualization
description: Cluster capabilities by domain: Core (file ops), Build, Version Control, Deployment, Analysis. Show as visual tech tree.

title: Basic prompt interaction loop
description: Implement the central prompt window for user interaction. Focus prompt with Enter, type request, submit to 'end turn'. Display visualization of coding process and results.

title: Phase 5: Capability Inventory
description: Tool/MCP discovery, capability clustering visualization, and dynamic updates as config changes.

title: Keyboard navigation framework
description: Implement vim-style keyboard navigation with normal/insert/visual modes. Support configurable keybindings (vim or emacs style). Navigation with h/j/k/l, view switching with 1-5, Tab for focus cycling.

title: Render self-reference connections in belt visualization
description:
Currently self-reference connections (where a package depends on itself internally) are skipped in belt rendering.

Future enhancement: render these as small loops or circular arrows attached to a single tile, showing internal dependencies within a package.

Reference: internal/belt/belt.go line ~117

title: Sound design (optional)
description: Optional audio feedback for key events via theme system. Build completion sounds, test pass/fail audio cues.

title: Theme support
description: Customize colors, sprites, and visual style. Support light/dark themes and custom color schemes.

title: Real metrics display for builds
description: Display actual build metrics: duration, cache statistics, pass/fail history, dependencies, last built timestamp. Show AI-suggested optimizations based on build graph analysis.

title: Basic resource tracking (real metrics)
description: Implement top resource bar showing real metrics: context tokens usage, API cost, build status, test coverage, CI status. Make extensible for custom resource types.

title: Phase 2: Buildings & Units
description: Build system adapters (npm, Bazel, cargo), real metrics display for builds, and test visualization with actual results.

title: Phase 4: Belts & Debugging
description: Dependency flow visualization (Factorio-style), visual debugging mode, and Python/TypeScript/Go support.

title: Weather/metrics system
description: Show metrics as weather: clear skies for nominal, storm clouds for elevated errors, drought for low traffic, floods for traffic spikes.

title: Deployment visualization
description: Visualize deployed services as cities on a world map. Cities represent services, population shows active users/requests.

title: Phase 6: Production Realm
description: Deployment visualization, service health monitoring, and weather/metrics system for production environments.

title: Phase 3: Advisors
description: Subagent configuration loading, insight generation from real analysis, and advisor consultation UI.

title: Scaffold Ebitengine (Go) prototype with async subprocess handling
description:
## Decision
Switch from Rust/SDL2 to Go/Ebitengine based on:
1. Goroutines + channels ideal for streaming subprocess output
2. Go is highly LLM-friendly (easy for AI to write)
3. Ebitengine is mature, stable API, lightweight 2D
4. Single binary output, cross-platform

## Scope
- [ ] Initialize Go module with Ebitengine dependency
- [ ] Basic game window with tile grid placeholder
- [ ] Goroutine that spawns `claude --output-format json` 
- [ ] Channel-based event system (subprocess -> game loop)
- [ ] Simple fog of war state (revealed/hidden per tile)
- [ ] Keyboard input handling (vim-style navigation)
- [ ] Prompt input area (bottom of screen)

## Out of Scope (for this task)
- Advisors, belts, buildings, units
- Real codebase parsing
- Production deployment visualization
